reviewNotes: Reviewed all 442 exported speech keys from 100 cards against data/real-conversation-400-3.json source furigana and vocabulary readings. Sentence/cloze prompts and full-sentence correct-answer explanations use 1.0; individual vocabulary and short combined choices use 0.85. Topic/contrast は -> わ checked by exact key and occurrence, including では. Lexical ごはん, はんぶん, はいれる/はいる, はっぴょう, はなし/はなしましょう, はたらきたい, はし, はんだん, はやおき, はじめました and はんい preserved. Directional 招待への -> しょうたいえの; lexical へんじ, へんしん, へいきん, へいじつ, へや, このへん and へんか preserved. Object を -> お checked in context. Wi-Fi explicitly rendered わいふぁい, preserving the Latin lookup key. Katakana converted to hiragana with long vowels and gemination retained (めーる, めっせーじ, あぷり, すまほ, ほてる, ねっと, いべんと, けーき, ぱん, まなー, るーる, こつ, ぽいんと, めりっと, でめりっと, たいみんぐ). Final punctuation added to fragments. Distinct display text and lookup keys unchanged. Text review only; audible articulation and pitch accent not verified. Explanations removed from all vocabulary-only cards at the user’s request. Retained exactly the existing reviewed prompts, choice lists and vocabulary recordings.
